book.title: A Short Vocabulary of the Natives of Van Diemen Land; and also of the Menero Downs, in Australia

about: Two columns: words collected by Lhotsky in 1835, and a list of 1803 from Péron's expedition, obtained by Robert Brown and added by the editors. E. and W. mark the east and west sides of the island.
